payload.reason: The evidence provides specific data on the performance impact of layer norm approximation in the discussed tasks, indicating a measurable reduction in performance due to this approximation.

claims.text: The layer norm approximation incurs an average performance reduction of 1.08% in THE-X compared to the baseline model.
Jointly finetuning the softmax estimation model and approximated layernorm leads to a performance drop of 0.4% in the regression task STS-B.
The approximation of layer norm is critical to the performance of THE-X, necessitating individual optimization for best results.
